model_correction_this_round.what: the composition of quality and trait bonuses
model_correction_this_round.old: multiplier = quality_factor * (1 + trait_bonus), so a Tier I emblem scored 0.10 of its stat
model_correction_this_round.new: multiplier = 1 + quality_bonus + net_trait_bonus, exactly as the client prints it
model_correction_this_round.evidence: all nine observed emblems reproduce to the digit; the old rule reproduced none
model_correction_this_round.consequence: the real multiplier range is about 1.1 to 2.6 rather than 0.09 to 3.15, so a banner reweights the stats far less violently than the pre-banner model assumed

action_taken_since.action: CHANGE CORE TO Xtreme Gaming, via the War Banner 更改战队 button
action_taken_since.outcome: Core moved TEAM VISION -> Xtreme Gaming (Xxs + Ame). The submission SUCCEEDED while Support was already Xtreme Gaming. Tokens 38 -> 38. The Core banner and the roll board were both unchanged.

duplicate_team_across_roles.finding: Core and Support are both Xtreme Gaming at the same time, submitted successfully.
duplicate_team_across_roles.supersedes: the previous PARTIAL grade based only on the chooser not greying the team out, and every earlier calculation that paid a distinctness constraint
duplicate_team_across_roles.consequence: There is no distinct-team constraint in production optimisation. Each role is now chosen independently as its own argmax.

war_banner_switch_is_free_on_target.finding: 38 -> 38 tokens across a successful team change, on the target account itself.
war_banner_switch_is_free_on_target.note: This reproduces the test-account experiment on a second account, so the free banner-preserving path is confirmed twice.

banner_preserved_on_target.finding: GPM 180% / Roshan 120% / Creep Score 180% with identical tiers, traits and order after the switch.

stat_reroll_outcome_distribution.why: Tier-1 guarantees only that a reroll produces a NEW stat and that a banner carries no duplicate stats. It says nothing about the probabilities. Every stat-reroll EV computed so far assumed a uniform draw, which is an assumption, not evidence.
stat_reroll_outcome_distribution.note: The three green-stat operations currently on the board are therefore not recommended.
